description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Felidar Guardian targeting Reveillark.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Reveillark.
Reveillark leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering it and Blasting Station, with Reveillark targeting Felidar Guardian and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Reveillark trigger, returning Felidar Guardian and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
